Part of what I've seen recently is a positive attitude can have a tremendous affect, not only on yourself but also on all those you come in contact with on a day to day basis.

There are nuances I wasn't able to explain right away but I feel there is more of an understanding now and I'd like to share. This is more on interactions with others who aren't quite fully comfortable in themselves and unable to face their current challenges.

The importance of being solidified in yourself is being able to resist what others project onto you and keep going in the same direction despite them. So if you are being positive and find yourself faltering take a moment and try to find if it is coming from you. If you can find no reason for it then it is most likely someone who is witnessing your positivity and having a negative reaction to it and projecting that back at you(this is usually unintentional as they are most likely in a bad place and such positivity shines on their current darkness and makes them feel it all the more). There is a reflecting and a letting go that they are missing and they don't realize their negativity can be felt by others, especially when directed right at someone specifically. However, continued positivity is almost irresistible. They will either find they can be happy despite whatever is bothering them or they will remove themselves from the area entirely(I see this especially at bars when I go out).

Anyhow... that is a beginning of an explanation. There is so much more but I'd like to hear what some of you think.
